cv.name: Rania Haroon
cv.headline: Junior Software Engineer: TypeScript services, Docker, on-call runbooks
cv.summary: Junior software engineer with two years of production TypeScript services. Moved four services to Docker Compose with health checks and wrote the runbook the on-call rotation uses; learning Go and Kubernetes now.

bullets: Moved four services from a hand-built VPS setup to Docker Compose with health checks; wrote the runbook the on-call rotation now uses.
Built and maintain the invoicing service (Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL) that issues about 9,000 invoices a month for the company’s logistics clients.
Cut the nightly reconciliation job from 41 minutes to 6 by replacing row-by-row updates with set-based SQL and adding two partial indexes.
Review pull requests for the billing team and paired with two interns through their first month.
Wrote Python scripts that cleaned and loaded retail sales CSVs into PostgreSQL for the analytics team (about 2 million rows a week).
Added unit tests to the ingestion scripts (pytest), raising coverage of the loader module from 0 to 71%.

projects.name: ledger-lite
projects.description: A small double-entry bookkeeping API in TypeScript (Fastify, PostgreSQL) that enforces balanced journal entries with a database constraint.

projects.name: chai-check
projects.description: A browser extension that flags insecure form actions (HTTP, mixed content), built while working through the PortSwigger Web Security Academy.

education.details: CGPA 3.4 / 4.0. Final-year project: offline-first attendance app for rural schools (React Native, SQLite).
